name: Seyf Bazar
tagline: Mobile storefront for a Tashkent electronics retailer
role: iOS and Android storefront app with a WooCommerce backend

scenes.title: Uzbek catalog, priced in UZS
scenes.body: Categories, featured and latest products load from the retailer's WooCommerce catalog over its REST API.

scenes.title: Sale price, specs and reviews
scenes.body: Product descriptions render from WooCommerce HTML, with wishlist, share and buy buttons pinned below.

scenes.title: Checkout with Payme and Click
scenes.body: Four steps from cart to order: cash orders post to WooCommerce, cards use the store's web checkout in-app.

scenes.title: Dark theme across the shop
scenes.body: Profile settings toggle dark mode and OneSignal push notifications, and switch between Uzbek and Russian.
